verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents clients for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and Web, with F-Droid and Flathub distribution. Hands-on reports confirm cross-OS sessions: Ubuntu with Mac, Windows controlling a Mac Mini, and Linux driving Windows. Missing for 10: a documented OS-version support matrix (a user found older macOS unsupported), cross-OS feature parity (alt-tab and Linux-to-Windows file copy-paste issues), and evidence of reliable mobile-to-desktop sessions (an Android tablet hard-rebooted when connecting to a PC).

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
